layout.fallback: If the button does not work, open this link:

verify.subject: Verify your email
verify.heading: Verify your email
verify.body: Confirm {email} to finish signing up for {app}.
verify.footer: If you did not create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your password
reset.heading: Reset your password
reset.body: Choose a new password for your {app} account.
reset.footer: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.

invitation.subject: Join {organization}
invitation.heading: You are invited
invitation.footer: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

signUpAttempt.subject: Sign-up attempt
signUpAttempt.preview: Someone tried to create an account with your email
signUpAttempt.heading: Sign-up attempt
signUpAttempt.body: Someone tried to create an account using {email}. If this was you, sign in instead.
signUpAttempt.footer: If this was not you, you can ignore this email.

changeEmailConfirm.subject: Confirm your new email
changeEmailConfirm.heading: Confirm the email change
changeEmailConfirm.body: You asked to change the email of your {app} account from {email} to {newEmail}. Confirm, then open the link we send to the new address.
changeEmailConfirm.footer: If you did not ask for this, ignore this email and consider changing your password.

changeEmailVerify.subject: Verify your new email
changeEmailVerify.preview: One last step to use {email} with {app}
changeEmailVerify.heading: Verify your new email
changeEmailVerify.body: Open this link to start signing in to {app} with {email}.
changeEmailVerify.footer: If you did not ask for this, you can ignore this email.
